decisions.reason: Removing the Aave yield connector does not change automatic wallet payout or any other prize-claim behavior.
Chainlink VRF winner selection is independent of depositing prize-pool funds through Aave.
The decision removes only the redundant yield connector; it does not alter the Small Block prizes, trigger, eligibility, or pool funding.
The decision removes only the redundant yield connector; it does not alter the Big Block prizes or draw condition.
Aave removal does not change ticket eligibility, expiration, burning, resetting, or carry-forward rules.
A complete same-message MODIFY already removes the Aave Connector and Yield Generation entries from the About-page topic lists, leaving no additional stale top-level attribute.
No-referral ticket quantity and recipient selection remain valid without the Aave connector.
No-referral commission allocation is independent of prize-pool yield generation.
Removing Aave does not change the mint price, commission, founder share, or continued allocation to the Small and Big Block prize pools.
Public unauthenticated access to leaderboards and pool values remains valid after removal of the pool-yield connector.
The Transak fiat-mint flow and its deferred lifecycle are unrelated to Aave prize-pool yield generation.
Transactional email delivery and notification content do not depend on the Aave connector.
